audience: marketing and content teams that render social cards, banners and screenshots as images

useCases.title: Render an HTML card as an image
useCases.text: Send HTML and CSS, or a public URL, and get a hosted image back. Each render uses image credits, so check the usage first.

useCases.title: Render a saved template with new values
useCases.text: List the saved templates and read one to see its variables. Render it with the values you give; each render uses image credits.

useCases.title: Check image credits and rendered images
useCases.text: Read the image credits used per hour, day and month. List the images you rendered, newest first.
